scope: Node + jsdom, fixed wall-first input (m9-fixed, ellipse wall, maxLanes 8), mode medieval, one run each. districtPlanSerialMs: planPerimeterDistrict per district in series. criticalPath: contiguous runs of districts per worker; balanced: largest outline first to the least loaded worker. Estimates the parallel plan time as the slowest worker's share; worker start-up and message latency are not included. cloneOutMs: structured clone of all district results.
